title: Identification of aging-related genes in diagnosing osteoarthritis via integrating bioinformatics analysis and machine learning.
authors: Huang, Jian; Zhou, Jiangfei; Xue, Xiang; Dai, Tianming; Zhu, Weicong; Jiao, Songsong; Wu, Hang; Meng, Qingqi
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学和机器学习识别骨关节炎衰老相关诊断基因，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteoarthritis (OA) is one of the main causes of pain and disability in the world, it may be caused by many factors. Aging plays a significant role in the onset and progression of OA. However, the mechanisms underlying it remain unknown. Our research aimed to uncover the role of aging-related genes in the progression of OA. METHODS: In Human OA datasets and aging-related genes were obtained from the GEO database and the HAGR website, respectively. Bioinformatics methods including Gene Ontology (GO), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes Genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment, and Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis were used to analyze differentially expressed aging-related genes (DEARGs) in the normal control group and the OA group. And then weighted gene coexpression network analysis (WGCNA), the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression, and the Random Forest (RF) machine learning algorithms were used to find the hub genes. RESULTS: Four overlapping hub genes: HMGB2, CDKN1A, JUN, and DDIT3 were identified. According to the nomogram model and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, four hub DEARGs had good diagnostic value in distinguishing normal from OA. Furthermore, the qRT-PCR test demonstrated that HMGB2, CDKN1A, JUN, and DDIT3 mRNA expression levels were lower in OA group than in normal group. CONCLUSION: Finally, these four-hub aging-related genes may help us understand the underlying mechanism of aging in osteoarthritis and could be used as possible diagnostic and therapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨关节炎（OA）是全球疼痛和残疾的主要原因之一，可能由多种因素引起。衰老在OA的发生和进展中起着重要作用。然而，其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们的研究旨在揭示衰老相关基因在OA进展中的作用。方法：从GEO数据库和HAGR网站分别获取人类OA数据集和衰老相关基因。采用生物信息学方法，包括基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析，分析正常对照组和OA组中差异表达的衰老相关基因（DEARGs）。随后，使用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）、最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）回归以及随机森林（RF）机器学习算法来寻找核心基因。结果：鉴定出四个重叠的核心基因：HMGB2、CDKN1A、JUN和DDIT3。根据列线图模型和受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析，四个核心DEARGs在区分正常与OA方面具有良好的诊断价值。此外，qRT-PCR检测显示，OA组中HMGB2、CDKN1A、JUN和DDIT3的mRNA表达水平低于正常组。结论：最终，这四个衰老相关核心基因可能有助于我们理解衰老在骨关节炎中的潜在机制，并可作为可能的诊断和治疗靶点。
